description: This file defines a custom Akka Streams GraphStage called MergeSortedAsPair, which merges two sorted streams into a stream of pairs representing the elements before final comparison. It includes methods for creating instances with comparators or natural ordering, and handles stream completion with padding using a maximal element.

classes.name: MergeSortedAsPair
classes.description: A custom Akka Streams GraphStage that merges two sorted streams into pairs of elements, delivering the tuple before final comparison, with padding for exhausted streams using a maximal element.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Creates a merged source from two sources according to a comparator, producing pairs of elements from the input streams.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a MergeSortedAsPair stage for a comparable type using the natural order defined by Comparable.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a MergeSortedAsPair stage with a custom comparator and a maximal element.
